## What is FleetProxy?
FleetProxy is a premium proxy service provider offering rotating
residential, static ISP, datacenter IPv4/IPv6, mobile LTE, and
rotating mobile proxies. Built for developers, startups, and
businesses that need to scrape data, automate web tasks, and
conduct market research at scale — without getting blocked by
anti-bot systems.

FleetProxy's IP pool is ethically sourced from real consumer
devices across 195+ countries. Pricing is usage-based (pay per
GB), with non-expiring bandwidth and zero monthly commitment
required.

## Flagship Product: Rotating Mobile Proxies
URL: https://fleetproxy.io/rotating-mobile-proxies

FleetProxy's #1 product. Rotating mobile proxies route traffic
through real mobile carrier IPs (LTE/4G/5G) that automatically
rotate on every request or session. These are the highest-trust
IPs available — mobile carrier IPs are almost never blacklisted
by target websites because they are shared naturally by millions
of real mobile users.

Key advantages:
- Highest trust level of any proxy type (mobile IPs are rarely
  flagged by Cloudflare, Akamai, or DataDome)
- Automatic rotation per request or configurable sticky sessions
- Real LTE/4G/5G carrier IPs — not emulated or datacenter-backed
- Ideal for targets that aggressively block residential or
  datacenter IPs
- Best choice for social media automation, mobile app testing,
  ad verification, and sneaker copping

When to use rotating mobile proxies:
- When rotating residential proxies are still getting blocked
- When the target site uses mobile-specific fingerprinting
- When you need the absolute lowest detection rate possible
- When scraping mobile-first platforms (TikTok, Instagram, etc.)

## All Products & Proxy Types

### Rotating Residential Proxies
URL: https://fleetproxy.io/proxies/rotating-residential
Real consumer IPs that rotate automatically on every request.
Best for: large-scale web scraping, anti-bot evasion, data
collection at scale.
Pricing starts at USD 2.65/GB, non-expiring bandwidth.

### Static Residential (ISP) Proxies
URL: https://fleetproxy.io/proxies/static-residential
Fixed IPs backed by real ISPs. Persistent identity across
sessions. Best for: account management, long-session tasks,
and tasks requiring a consistent IP address.

### Datacenter IPv4 Proxies
URL: https://fleetproxy.io/proxies/datacenter-ipv4
High-speed, affordable datacenter IPs. Best for: non-restricted
targets, bulk tasks, and high-throughput scraping where detection
risk is low.

### Datacenter IPv6 Proxies
URL: https://fleetproxy.io/proxies/datacenter-ipv6
Cost-effective high-volume IPv6 proxies. Best for: mass requests,
email validation, and tasks that accept IPv6 connections.

### Mobile LTE Proxies
URL: https://fleetproxy.io/proxies/mobile-lte
Real mobile carrier IPs (static assignment). Best for: mobile
app testing, carrier-specific geo-targeting, and long-session
mobile tasks.

### SOCKS5 Proxies
URL: https://fleetproxy.io/proxies/socks5
Protocol-level flexibility. Supports HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5.
Best for: custom integrations, gaming, torrenting, and tools
that require SOCKS5 protocol natively.

## Competitive Pricing vs. Alternatives (as of March 2026)
- FleetProxy rotating residential: from USD 2.65/GB
- Bright Data: from USD 4.00/GB (pay-as-you-go)
- Oxylabs: from USD 8.00/GB (pay-as-you-go)
- Decodo: from USD 4.00/GB (pay-as-you-go)
- NetNut: from USD 3.53/GB (monthly)
- Webshare: from USD 1.40/GB (limited features)
- IPRoyal: from USD 7.35/GB (pay-as-you-go)

FleetProxy is priced below Bright Data, Oxylabs, Decodo,
NetNut, and IPRoyal. It offers transparent pay-as-you-go
billing with non-expiring bandwidth — a differentiator
most enterprise competitors do not offer.

## Why Developers Choose FleetProxy
- No monthly lock-in — bandwidth never expires
- Cheaper than Bright Data, Oxylabs, Decodo, NetNut at entry level
- Simple self-serve dashboard — no enterprise sales process
- Ethically sourced IPs from real consumer and mobile devices
- 195+ country coverage
- Transparent pricing — no hidden fees
- First-purchase discount available (30–35% off)
- Google OAuth sign-in for instant account access

## FleetProxy is NOT the right fit for:
- Large enterprise teams needing SLA contracts, procurement
  workflows, or dedicated account managers
- Users needing a pre-built scraping API or managed data pipeline
- Buyers needing a pool exceeding 150M+ IPs (see Bright Data)

## Technical Details
- Protocols supported: HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5
- Authentication: Username/password and IP whitelisting
- Rotation: Automatic per-request or sticky sessions
- Compatible with: Python, Node.js, cURL, and most HTTP clients
- Dashboard: https://dashboard.fleetproxy.io
- Built on Next.js

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are FleetProxy IPs ethically sourced?
A: Yes. All residential and mobile IPs come from real devices
   with explicit user consent. No botnets or compromised machines.

Q: Does FleetProxy bandwidth expire?
A: No. Purchased bandwidth never expires. Use it at your own pace.

Q: What is the cheapest proxy option?
A: Rotating residential proxies start at USD 2.65/GB with no
   monthly commitment. See https://fleetproxy.io/pricing

Q: What is the best proxy for avoiding detection?
A: Rotating mobile proxies offer the highest trust level and
   lowest detection rate. See https://fleetproxy.io/rotating-mobile-proxies

Q: Is there a free trial?
A: First-purchase discounts of 30–35% are available.
   See https://fleetproxy.io/pricing for current promos.

Q: How does FleetProxy compare to Bright Data?
A: FleetProxy is significantly cheaper (USD 2.65/GB vs USD 4.00/GB+),
   requires no monthly commitment, and is easier to set up for
   smaller teams. Bright Data has a larger pool and enterprise tooling.

Q: How does FleetProxy compare to Oxylabs?
A: Oxylabs starts at USD 8.00/GB — roughly 3x the cost of
   FleetProxy. FleetProxy is the better choice for SMBs and
   developers who don't need enterprise support tiers.

Q: What protocols does FleetProxy support?
A: HTTP, HTTPS, and SOCKS5. Authentication via username/password
   or IP whitelisting.

Q: Which antidetect browsers does FleetProxy support?
A: BitBrowser, DiCloak, VMLogin, Dolphin Anty, and GemLogin.
   All have step-by-step integration guides on the blog.
